name: Umbral Reja
motion: The pair swings inward: the active leaf opens 84°, then the second leaf; they close in reverse so the astragal laps (Doors_Swing, 7 s). Door_Active opens the active leaf alone (4.6 s).

sizes.label: 2.44 m · two 915 mm leaves, sidelites and transom (default)
2.74 m · two 915 mm leaves, sidelites and transom
3.05 m · two 915 mm leaves, sidelites and transom

options: Configuration (12 variants): sidelites and transom / sidelites only / transom only / doors only × divided grid / horizontal bars / open glass
Handle: lever on a narrow plate, round lever on a slim plate, turned knob
Hardware finish (4): Bronce Umbra, Latón Cepillado, Anodizado Natural, Negro Carbón

hotspots.title: Swing the pair
hotspots.text: Tap to open. The active leaf swings in first and the second follows; they close in reverse, so the astragal laps cleanly.

hotspots.title: Lever and mortise lock
hotspots.text: A solid lever on a narrow plate over a mortise lock with a 44 mm backset. Tap to open the active leaf alone.

hotspots.title: 32 mm glazing bars
hotspots.text: Steel bars 32 mm wide on both faces, with a spacer between the panes. Grid, horizontal bars or open glass.

hotspots.title: Barrel hinges
hotspots.text: Adjustable steel barrel hinges on ball bearings, finished with the frame. Three per leaf at 2.44 m, four above.

hotspots.title: Brass sill
hotspots.text: A brass threshold with a stop the leaves close against. It is set to the finished floor.

hotspots.title: Fixed sidelites
hotspots.text: 356 mm of fixed glass each side, glazed and barred like the doors. Remove them, or the transom, in the configuration.

hotspots.title: 22 mm insulated glass
hotspots.text: Two 4.8 mm tempered lites with a low-e coat, 22 mm overall. Claro, Acanalado or Satinado.

gaps: All profile dimensions are estimates from the source build (no public section drawings). Overall sizes are for sidelites + transom; other configurations are narrower or lower.
Glass types are finishes on the glass material (as in the source), not show/hide meshes; checked live: Satinado stays translucent but reads subtly.
The model loads in Negro Carbón (the GLB's own colour) until a steel swatch is picked; Bronce Umbra is the first swatch.
Source Gray, Chestnut Brown, Antique Bronze, Rustic Copper finishes and Obscure glass dropped (no close Umbral match).
Configuration/grid are variants, so switching them resets height, handle and finishes (platform behaviour). Hero camera does not reframe for 3.05 m.
Stills: wall and floor are render-scene context only (the GLB has none). No video made.
A retry race left one unused 'Claro' texture record in the account library (no material uses it).
